versions.content: Support configuration of BSW Type: valid Description: ECU Configuration SHALL support all configuration parameters defined in the BSW SWS documents. The list of all supported modules can be found in the Layered Software Architecture document [11]. Rationale: The BSW has to be configured out of the ECU Configuration description. Use Case: • BSW SWS define a list of configuration parameters. These parameters need to be reflected in the ECU Configuration template. • The OS SWS will identify configuration parameters from existing formats (such as OIL) and place them in the SWS. In that case only the content of OIL is used in the ECUC, not the actual format itself. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: Related released specifications of BSW modules [11].
